scope: User-reported manual hardware acceptance of local hub operation in both native PRO DJ LINK settings

activation_evidence.method: Hash-verified USB copy, explicitly authorized exact-candidate pre-approval and normal AZ-MODS apply

manual_reports.prompt: Open the hub source, browse, load and play a track; report the Link setting.
manual_reports.result: User confirms local hub operation with Link Off.

manual_reports.prompt: Enable native PRO DJ LINK; check continued playback on deck1 or2, CAMI source availability and another track load.
manual_reports.result: User confirms the requested local checks after enabling Link; individual timings and audio were not instrumented.

limitations: Subsequent user clarification: changing Link Off/On in either direction briefly removes and reannounces the hub source. Its previously loaded track gains the native source-unavailable warning triangle, while a simultaneously loaded native USB track/source remains connected. Earlier confirmations establish basic usability, not uninterrupted source identity or warning-free loaded transitions. The user requested recording this issue and continuing tests; it is not resolved or classified as unavoidable.
User-reported manual results, not agent-instrumented playback/audio acceptance.
No external player was reported connected; physical external-player discovery, master/sync and coexistence remain unvalidated.
No separate four-deck hardware matrix, eight-source hardware acceptance, long-session or cache-capacity claim.
Candidate loaded-eject regression and full controller cold-start/recovery were not tested in this trial.
